correctness.rationale: For every d>=4, a generic simplex section corresponds to an edge cut of size d of Q_d; hypercube minimum edge cuts of size d isolate a singleton vertex (or its complement). For each normal the two extreme intercept intervals total 2 min_i a_i|u_i|, and conditional Crofton width is sum_i a_i|u_i|. Gaussian radial independence gives the exact erfc integral. The expected minimum is strictly Schur-concave via positive-measure switch under unequal pairwise averaging; at equal sides half-normal small-t asymptotics yield d^2 p_d -> pi. Independent 3D sampled integral checks and direct dimensional algebra supported normalization; full proof is analytic for arbitrary d and a_i. Repaired source explicitly restricts new mathematical claim to d>=4.
